author: cli
text: Re-read 2026-08-17 for the backlog session. Both claims verified against the code: the docstring's 'idempotent - never overwrites files the user already has' holds (it checks .coord, checks .mcp.json, and routes rule files through plan_rules_write), and the inline 'One template, three filenames, one pass' is exact - RULE_FILES is ('AGENTS.md','CLAUDE.md','GEMINI.md'), three names, one rules_document() call. The rot flag came from body churn during the 0.55.x releases, not from anything these comments assert.
